title: Reference approach: Signal Frequency Analyzer
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Create/load a signal with a documented sampling interval.
Apply a window when appropriate and compute an FFT.
Convert bins to frequencies using the sample interval.
Compare expected and recovered frequencies and discuss leakage/normalization.
explanation: Analyze a sampled signal in the frequency domain and report its dominant frequency. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
